title: Receptionist/Administrator
company: Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are seeking friendly, motivated, and highly organised Receptionists to join our new Surgical Elective Centre and to work across our existing John Radcliffe and West Wing Theatres at Oxford University Hospitals. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy patient-facing environment and is committed to delivering outstanding customer service. As the first point of contact for patients, carers and visitors, you will be an important ambassador for our theatres and play a key role in ensuring every patient receives a safe, welcoming and positive experience. Duties include checking patients in and out of theatre suites, responding to telephone and face-to-face enquiries, preparing theatre lists and other paperwork, and maintaining an organised and professional reception area. You will work closely with nurses, surgeons, anaesthetists and administrative colleagues to support patient flow, manage queries, arrange patient transport or interpreters when required, and scan correspondence into electronic patient records. You will also handle emails and EPR messages, ensuring information is processed in a timely and accurate manner. We are looking for someone who has excellent communication and customer service skills, can work independently using their own initiative, is confident with computer systems, and remains calm and supportive in a fast-paced environment. A commitment to the Trust value of Compassionate Excellence is essential. Job Description Job Title: Clinical Receptionist/administrator for Surgical Elective Centre Theatre Grade Band 3 Job Summary: You will be the first point of contact for patients arriving at our Theatres and will provide a professional and reassuring welcome for those attending for surgery, ensuring a high standard of patient experience. You will be responsible for the provision of a professional, comprehensive and efficient reception and booking service for patients and members of the department and managing the patient pathway throughout their stay in the theatre suite. Job Title Clinical Receptionist/administrator for NOTSSCaN Theatres We are seeking friendly, motivated and highly organised Receptionists to join our new Surgical Elective Centre as well as working across our existing John Radcliffe and West Wing Theatres at Oxford University Hospitals. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy patientfacing environment and is committed to delivering outstanding customer service. As the first point of contact for patients, carers and visitors, you will be an important ambassador for our theatres and play a key role in ensuring every patient receives a safe, welcoming and positive experience. Duties include checking patients in and out of theatre suites, responding to telephone and facetoface enquiries, preparing theatre lists and other paperwork, and maintaining an organised and professional reception area. We are looking for someone who has excellent communication and customer service skills, can work independently using their own initiative, is confident with computer systems, and remains calm and supportive in a fastpaced environment. A commitment to the Trust value of Compassionate Excellence is essential. You will be a part of a team of four and will be expected to work flexibly with other team members to ensure our reception area is staffed from 07:00 am until 08:30 pm. Receptionist Responsibilities 1. Act as the first point of contact for patients and visitors to the department . 2. Provide comprehensive reception support, to include taking messages and using the department technology. 3. Deal with patient enquiries in a sympathetic and confidential manner, signposting people appropriately and maintain a high standard of customer care at all times. 4. Update Trust patient information systems to ensure accurate patient information and demographics are recorded. 5. Book, amend and check all patients accurately. Clerical 1. Provide assistance to clinical and administrative staff within the theatre suite and other areas of the trust as part of the patients pathway. 2. Use the appropriate Trust record systems to retrieve, book in or out (track) and send out patient notes to other services as requested. 3. Open incoming post and distribute to clinical and administrative staff as required. 4. Answer the telephone, log, manage and prioritise requests as necessary. 5. Book interpreter services for patients as required. General 1. Demonstrate high levels of customer care and be an ambassador for our theatre suites and the Trust more widely. 2. Provide a robust administration function that underpins the delivery of a high-quality service and maintain effective working relationships with clinical, nursing and administrative staff. 3. Answer all communication including telephone, email and face to face queries, in a timely manner and action as appropriate. 4. Maintain patient confidentiality at all times. 5. Be flexible in your approach to work, such as covering other job roles at an appropriate grade or site, and to include varying working hours to ensure the service maintains a minimum level of cover during its core hours. 6. Take responsibility for all communications received and distribute appropriately to the clinical and administrative staff within the service. 7. Arrange patient transport as necessary, in line with Trust procedures. 8. Attend Departmental meetings and training as required to ensure that you maintain an up-to-date working knowledge of service and trust procedures. 9. Act in a manner aligned to our Trust Values and consistently demonstrate the behaviours that will ensure we achieve our ambition of delivering compassionate excellence. 10. Any other duties at the request of the departmental managers, which may be needed to fulfil the objectives of the post, which are appropriate to the grade.

title: Email Campaign Executive
description:
Ready to make your mark in digital marketing?

If you love getting stuck into email campaigns, spotting what makes a subject line work, and turning data into decisions, this could be your next big move.

An exciting opportunity has opened up for an Email Campaign Executive to join a well-established manufacturer in the safety equipment sector, based in Oxfordshire. This is a genuinely international business, and this role puts you right at the centre of how they communicate with their global distribution network.

You'll take ownership of email marketing campaigns from planning through to reporting, working closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across multiple regions. It's a role with real variety, real responsibility, and real opportunity to grow.

On offer is a salary of £27,000 plus a bonus of up to £2,000 a year, paid quarterly based on sales targets. You'll also get 25 days holiday, an employer-matched pension, a personal development plan, Perkbox discounts, a wellbeing programme, and a cycle-to-work scheme. The role is office-based (with WFH one day a week once you're through probation), so you'll need your own transport to get there.

Key Responsibilities:
- Plan, build and send email campaigns for the company's global distribution network
- Manage a global campaign calendar so every send lands on time
- Build targeted campaigns around customer needs and business goals
- Create and manage automated journeys, nurture campaigns and lead generation
- Work closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across different regions
- Keep the marketing database clean and GDPR-compliant
- Run A/B tests to keep improving campaign performance
- Track KPIs and turn the numbers into clear, actionable insight
- Make sure every campaign matches company brand guidelines and technical accuracy
- Support event promotion and follow-up lead nurturing
- Spot opportunities to improve automation, reporting and campaign efficiency

Skills & Experience:
- 2+ years' experience in email marketing, campaign management or marketing automation
- Experience in a B2 B marketing environment
- Confident with CRM systems and customer data
- Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms and automation tools
- Comfortable analysing performance data and turning it into recommendations
- Experience building campaign reports and dashboards
- Sharp attention to detail and solid project management skills
- Strong written communication and copywriting ability
- Able to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines at once
- A team player who's used to working across marketing, sales and product
- Bonus points for experience with international markets or multi-language campaigns

How to Apply:

This is a genuine chance to grow your marketing career inside an established, international manufacturer, with training, support and real ownership from day one. If you're re ady to take the next step, apply now or contact Niche Recruitment with any questions.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Oxfordshire

£30-40k

VR/10568

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a skilled Marketing Executive to join a successful and well-established company based in Oxfordshire, who are part of a large international group. They are now embarking on an exciting phase of growth and this is a new role to help increase their impact and reach.

This role is perfect for an all round marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building from the ground up.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing Executive will primarily focus on D2 C and B2 B funnels optimisation. Your work will directly contribute to brand awareness, lead generation, and revenue growth.

Your role will involve:
- Brand - Keep consistency within the company's core brand values, tone, and visual identity across all customer-facing assets (website, social media, email, print, etc.).
- Campaigns and Email Marketing - Develop, execute, and optimise multi-channel campaigns (email, social, paid, organic) to drive conversion.
- A/B test subject lines, CTAs, and content to refine performance.
- SEO, Content and Design - Create and optimise landing pages, blog posts,and marketing collateral.
- Conduct keyword research and implement on-page SEO best practices (meta tags, headers, internal linking) to improve organic search rankings.
- Design on marketing materials (social posts,brochures, presentations) using brand guidelines
- Social media - Manage and grow the company's presence on LinkedIn (B2 B) and Instagram (D2 C and B2 B), tailoring content for each audience.
- Events - Coordinate with event partners to ensure seamless execution of conferences and planned activities
- CRM - Maintain data hygiene in the CRM (e.g., deduplication, missing information, tagging)
- Performance Marketing - Collect, visualise, and interpret performance data to inform decisions.

You will be the ideal candidate due to your:
- Previous marketing experience in B2 C and/or B2 B.
- Marketing generalist mindset: Comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting to evolving priorities
- Strong content marketing and storytelling skills: Ability to craft SEO-optimised narratives for diverse audiences.
- Data-driven decision-making: Proficient in analysing metrics (GA4, CRM reports and more) to optimise campaigns.
- Proactive and autonomous.
- Growth mindset: Curious, resourceful, and always seeking to learn and improve.
- Hands-on CRM experience.

Desirable
- HubSpot knowledge and/or certification
- Canva or designing tools (Adobe Suite, Figma)
- Brevo or other email marketing tools
- E-commerce platform i.e Shopify
- SEO/SEM knowledge: Basic understanding of technical SEO, backlinking, and paid search strategies
- Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple deadlines.

title: Administrator
description: Are you looking for a new office based challenge working for a hardworking enthusiastic and vibrant mental health service? We hope that the advert has given you a clear understanding of the skills we are seeking and the opportunity at hand. You will need to use the supporting statement element of your application form to demonstrate your suitability for this role and you should refer to the job description, person specification and the guidance notes attached to this role to help you tailor your application.
